description: This file defines a login form component using React, Formik, and Yup for validation. It includes form fields for email and password, a checkbox for 'remember me', and a link to registration. It exports a default login form component.

classes.name: FormValues
classes.description: Interface defining the shape of form values with 'identifier' and 'password'.

methods.description: React functional component rendering the login form fields and submit button.

methods.name: LoginForm
methods.description: Higher-order component wrapping InnerForm with Formik for form state management and validation.
